archetype_description: Grounded, warm, matte, and physical. Evokes trust, growth, and calm for users seeking recovery and mental wellness.

headings.usage: Use Outfit for expressive, approachable headings. Use 'tracking-tight' for large headings to maintain professionalism without feeling rigid.

body.usage: Use Work Sans for all body text, dashboard data, and input labels. Highly legible, warm humanist sans-serif.

hierarchy_rules: H1 (Hero): text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none text-brand-dark
H2 (Section): text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-brand-dark
Labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-brand-muted

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12, gap-8) for breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_pages: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric bento-style layouts for feature showcases. Heavy use of negative space.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard: Mode B: Control Room Grid. Standardized bento boxes (gap-6). Solid flat backgrounds. No glassmorphism.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Flat solid background, 1px border-brand-muted (10% opacity), rounded-2xl. Soft diffuse shadow on hover only.

components.buttons: rounded-full for primary CTA to feel approachable. Primary buttons use bg-brand-primary text-white hover:bg-brand-primary-hover. Secondary buttons use transparent bg, 1px border-brand-muted, text-brand-charcoal hover:bg-background-card_hover.
components.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn highly customized. rounded-xl, border-brand-muted, bg-white. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav. Solid bg-background-base/95 backdrop-blur-md. Border bottom 1px border-brand-muted. No fully transparent headers.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='signup-submit-btn').

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with ambient shadow (shadow-md). Text color explicitly defined on hover to maintain 4.5:1 contrast.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out for buttons and cards.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-in up (y: 20, opacity: 0) for lists and dashboard widgets.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, warm charcoal or primary color. Avoid harsh black icons.

media.strategy: Avoid generic tech/SaaS illustrations. Use warm, natural, sunlit photography focusing on growth, peace, and human connection.

hero_background.alt: Sunrise over a peaceful green landscape
hero_background.usage: Main landing page hero background. Apply a linear gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-background-base/90 to-background-base/40) to ensure text contrast.

school_of_mental_wellness.usage: Feature block for School of Mental Wellness or Onboarding flow.

school_of_life_skills.usage: Feature block for School of Life Skills.

platform_university_vibe.usage: About section or Phase 2/3 preview page banner.

dashboard_texture.usage: Subtle background texture for AI Professor interaction panels or Certificate backgrounds (opacity 5-10%).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. DO NOT default to Tailwind blue/indigo.
Use Outfit for Headings and Work Sans for Body. Load these via Google Fonts in index.css.
Implement Shadcn, but remove default border radiuses from standard tech looks; use rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for primary CTAs.
Dashboard must be built on a CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) using the gap-6 bento box style.
Ensure all text has a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the bone-white (F9F8F6) or white backgrounds.
Use the provided media URLs exclusively. Do not use placeholder images.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
